# Briana Maximino

### Marketing Strategy • Sports Marketing • Brand Engagement

I’m a Business Administration student with a concentration in Marketing at Cal Poly Pomona. My portfolio highlights my work in brand strategy, campaign planning, consumer insights, and data-driven marketing projects.

My work combines creative thinking with data, visuals, and clear communication. I use this portfolio to show how I plan campaigns, explain marketing ideas, organize insights, and present projects in a professional way.

## About Me

I am interested in how brands connect with people through storytelling, data, and real experiences. My academic projects have helped me practice campaign planning, marketing research, data visualization, and professional presentation design.

Through this portfolio, I want to show both sides of my marketing work: the creative side and the analytical side.
